_doc: Runtime budget for the ci.yml `web` job (design 06 §6.3, wave PV8).
CALIBRATED 2026-07-02 against the first real CI run (run 28603154535,
the v4.2.0 release push): e2e step 77s wall, container build 27s,
whole web job 131s on the 4-vCPU runner. Budgets = measured reference
plus headroom for suite growth (~2x e2e, ~2x job); job_fail_seconds
stays the design CONSTANT (fail > 10 min); timeout-minutes: 12 is the
hard deck above it. Sharding trigger unchanged: three consecutive runs
over e2e_budget_seconds => activate wave PV11 (shard matrix).
